sloka: रामः स्नात्वा तु नियतः गुणवान् जप्य कोविदः ।सम्ग्रहेणाकरोत्सर्वान् मन्त्रन् सत्रावसानिकान् ॥२-५६-२९॥
transliteration: rāmaḥ snātvā tu niyataḥ guṇavān japya kovidaḥ ।samgraheṇākarotsarvān mantran satrāvasānikān ॥2-56-29॥

translations.english: Virtuous Rama, who was an expert in the recitation of mantras, took his bath and his mind controlled, intoned briefly all the mantras appropriate to the completion of the ritual.
